content:
The highly anticipated return of "Ted Lasso" is finally here, with the fourth season set to premiere on Apple TV+ next week (watch here). Apple has just released the official trailer.

"Ted Lasso" Season 4 trailer focuses on beloved returning characters and the team's new signings

Next week will see the biggest premiere on Apple TV+ this year — "Ted Lasso" Season 4, airing on August 5.

This hit comedy starring Jason Sudeikis is returning more than three years after its previous season aired. The focus of the new season will shift from the AFC Richmond men's team to the newly formed "Lady Greyhounds."

For a complete introduction to all the new cast members and which returning members will be absent, check this out.

The new trailer released today doesn't reveal too many plot details, but instead evokes the warm spirit of "Ted Lasso" through the soundtrack of Mumford & Sons and clips of the beloved characters.

Below is the official synopsis for Season 4, along with the new trailer:

If you love "Ted Lasso," "Trying" is another heartwarming comedy worth recommending, currently streaming on Apple TV+. Its fifth season is airing now, earning a high score of 97% on Rotten Tomatoes.

What do you think of the new "Ted Lasso" trailer? Feel free to share in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, and discounts are also available through Apple One bundles.
